**`src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts`** — Defines the `ILeavePolicyRepository` interface with all 7 method signatures (`findById`, `findAll`, `findByLeaveType`, `findActive`, `create`, `update`, `delete`), following the same structural pattern as `IEmployeeRepository` and `IAuditRepository` (async `Promise<T>` returns, `Omit<>` for create inputs, `Partial<>` for update inputs, `null` for not-found returns).

- TypeScript compilation (`tsc --noEmit`): ✅ zero errors
